scope: Local regression and release preparation; production rollout recorded separately.

regressions.closed_idle_carriers: Failed on the original server; passes after proactive EOF polling and replenishment.
regressions.half_close_cleanup: Real TCP and duplex tests release abandoned half-closed sessions while preserving progressing responses and quiet fully open sessions.
regressions.enrollment: All 13 service tests pass in a disposable root container, including attachment without restarting its owner.
regressions.framing: Existing wire encoding, backpressure and half-close tests pass; silent carriers expire while heartbeats extend liveness.

checks.strict_clippy: porthub-io, porthub-network and porthub-edge, all targets/features, no dependencies
checks.static_linux_package: Local x86_64 musl build, no ELF interpreter, checksum and three packaged CLI lifecycle tests passed before the version-only bump.

build_cache_limit: Local rebuild includes an IO edit plus an agent runtime mtime change; it is not a controlled before/after CI performance comparison. Release linking remains required.
rollout_safety: Preserve routing, access rules and non-PortHub services. Back up the edge image/Compose settings and each agent registration before activation.
